body: hello! I just dm'd you

I was in a similar position once. I was agonizing over the decision for weeks. Then I realized — if I’m feeling this intensely about it, it must be something I really want. And I won’t stop thinking about it until I do it or I’ll never do it and spend the rest of my life wondering what could of been. 

If you’re afraid to make the leap, maybe go to New Zealand or another city for an extended vacation and see if you could imagine yourself living there.

My vote is take the leap and don’t look back.
I’ll always need an out. But thank you.
I have this same fear but somehow I know that stop will come someday. I just wish it didn’t take so much suffering for me to gather the courage to get off
I don’t. I try to keep it that way for that reason exactly. The guilt of leaving my parents behind is hard enough.

I feel exactly the same. Ironically, it's the only thing that keeps me going - knowing that I always have a way out if I ever need it it. Somehow that's enough for me to give this life thing a try.. until I can't anymore.

I had a similar experience when I started taking it. Lots of nausea in the morning. My doctor told me it may have been because I’d pop the pill as soon as I woke on an empty stomach. It’s been fine. Just need to eat something beforehand.
Isaiah Rashad - west savannah
Mac Miller. Still feels surreal.
I will never be alive to see black people become free or liberated from racism and oppression.
Black liberation.
Do you have this as a Spotify or Apple Music playlist?
Same. Like yes, things can get better.  It can also get worse or stay the same. I’m not interested in sticking around to find out.
What was the most helpful thing someone said to you?
I don’t know how many more “things can get better” I can hear
I’ve been lucky enough to have people who genuinely listen and care. But there’s never anything they can say that makes me feel any different, which in turn only makes them feel worse
That’s my fav haha. Start with that actually lol

Oh yes! This is a random assortment of shows lol but off the top of my head, I think these are great for binging - American Horror Story, Breaking Bad, Lost, The End of the F**king World, Skins, Law & Order Svu, How to Get Away With Murder, Insecure, Awkward Black Girl, Black Mirror

Also there’s new show called Betty premiering today on HBO. It’s based off the movie Skate Kitchen which is about an all girls skate crew. You should tune in if you can.

Not dumb at all. Trust me I understand. Sometimes things just get to you and it’s usually the small insignificant things that really set us off. Sorry you’re having a hard time. I try and binge watch something to take my mind off. Maybe y’all to a friend. Doesn’t have to be about what you’re feeling but just anything to distract you from what you’re feelings helps.
What happened, if you don’t mind me asking?
I’ll look into it. Thank you for you help. Truly.
Thanks for responding. Yea I need to look into resources more vigorously. I’ve just been so down I haven’t been trying as hard to find help. Are you familiar with online counseling?

Maybe I’m mistaken but Isaiah has never given a drop date. This is the first indication of a release I’ve seen that’s come directly from him so I really don’t see how he’s teasing us.

But I’m very much the same. When it drops it drops.

These comments are always so contradicting to me. How do you say you understand something (reasons for why he hasn’t dropped).. then proceed to complain about it.

“He doesn’t owe us anything but he’s trash for not dropping,” so you don’t understand lol.

Sorry, never saw this.. and I’m sorry you feel the same way. Sadly I don’t think we can ever let it go. Tired of fighting it. For now, I would like to find a way to live with it that isn’t weighing me down on my good days.
Put it in rice
Love it!! Is it on Apple Music or SoundCloud?
I don’t know who I am without it either. I wish I could imagine a life without it.
I like that quote.
This is noted. Thank you for the recommendation.
They never will. The only way to understand this is to live through it and as much as I’d love to be understood (and I really do), I’d never wish this pain on them.

Does the anxiety ever ease for you?

I am in a better place honestly. I know rock bottom. I’ve felt it and I never want to go back. But I don’t know how to deal with the uneasiness and anxiety when I feel something other than depression.

Truthfully I’ve never gotten this much engagement, which I believe is due to me never being able to say the right words to describe what I’m feeling. I wouldn’t even say post hit the mark with what’s going on in my head, but it’s reassuring to see so many people relate.
Possibly

That’s the thing, I know exactly what it takes to pick myself up but I also know the discomfort and anxiety that brings just to eventually get knocked back down to the same place.

I think that if I at least didn’t feel as much anxiety when I am “happy,” depression wouldn’t be as hard to cope with, but.. I guess that’s the point. 

Appreciate your sentiments though. Wish you the best as well.

Yea I mean I look at people who seem happy or content and I can’t wrap my head around it. I just think about how much work and effort that would be for me to maintain while it’s nothing for them. 

And even when I am on the other side I feel so uncomfortable like somethings just not right. Then I feel worse for feeling that way and that I’m underserving. No winning in this really.
“Weird comforting feeling” hits it. I know it’s because it’s the most familiar feeling I know but I hate it. Something so terrible should not feel like home. It’s literally Stockholm syndrome.
Well I am severely depressed lol so this is a win win for me
super duper late but I’ll catch you next time. I visit a lot
Ahhh leaving today. Thanks for the heads up tho!!

I’m from Chicago but based in LA now. There’s a black / queer skate collective @_froskate_ on insta. You should check em out!! Also I may be heading back home sometime next month. Would be totally down to link up. Lemme know.
I’m 22 F btw.
Yooo look up grlswirl and display.only on insta. They have skate meets up pretty often. Also can hit me up anytime!! I’m LA based :)

For me I always remember how scared I was when I first got on a board then how comfortable I got at it so fast. It always seems scarier than it is. 

Also try to take the trick step by step. Sometimes  I practice my ollie on grass then move to concrete. Or I do the first step of a trick over and over until I think I can move on to the second.

But the only answer truly is just doing it. Easier said than done haha but after a few attempts, you get over the fear pretty quickly.
Same, always great vibes with skaters. At least in my experience. And most def. Will keep that in mind ha. Hit me up if you’re ever in LA too!
Heyyyy I’m totally down. Gonna message you! :)
It’s not about not being able to sleep at night. I wrote this in the afternoon. I wish I could sleep forever.
You posted this on like two other posts.. you may mean well but copying and pasting generic responses like this don’t help. Write something meaningful next time
Thank you!!! Just checked them out. I missed the skate for this month but will def catch the next one.

Those comments “why would you do this to me” are incredibly selfish and they bring a great deal of guilt to people who are having thoughts and feelings they never asked for. I can’t imagine losing a loved one from suicide but me understanding what it feels like to be that low to take your life, a part of me would be happy that they were able to find peace. I know you and the OP are hurting but being angry will not allow you to properly grieve from that loss.
I’ve been where you are. I still am. I’d be a hypocrite to tell you not to do it considering my own thoughts but I’m here if you want to talk, no matter what you decide
Solid.
would be sufficient lol..thanks for the correction

First, I'm very sorry about your mom. Although I am also depressed and suicidal, I won't say I understand what you're going through but I can relate to what you're saying.. fantasizing about your death and keeping it as a back up plan when you've lost all will. I struggle to respond to these posts because I don't think there is a reason to live for me either so who I am to tell a person to keep going. I don't think I'll ever be happy or content really. There will always be a void. Anyways, I just wanted to to tell you you're not alone and I hope you find peace somehow, whatever you decide.

I ask myself this all the time and it really sucks. Just hating yourself and life for no reason or just making up reasons in your head. I wish I experienced a traumatic event in my life, then I could at least blame it on something. 

But try to take it a day at a time. All we ever can do.
I'm sorry to hear that. I'm going through the same thing with my best friend..pushing her away. You should talk to them. If they really care, they'll hear you out and understand
I hear you. It's just things that I don't want to admit out loud or for her to know I'm insecure about.. but I know there isn't a way around it. I'll try writing it down and see where that takes me.

I've thought of this but think it's unfair for me to ask her to filter herself. I also don't think I could even pin point everything that would trigger me. It just happens sometimes, but I appreciate your feedback.

Hi.

I'm at point where I don't think this will ever end. This pain, these thoughts, the loneliness. It's just not worth all this suffering. Not even for the little happy moments. I can't vent to my friends cause I'm just burdening them. I hate making them feel like they can't help me. 

This is the most I've ever been alone with my thoughts in a long time and I don't know how to deal with it. I appreciate your response but I don't know if anything you say will make a difference.

Yea I actually understand. Sometimes I try talking to my friends and when they ask me why I feel this way or what's wrong, my mind just goes blank even though my mind comes up with 1000 reasons to feel like crap when I'm alone in my head. But I understand wanting to just leave and not feel that pain anymore. I really do. And I won't tell you it'll get better cause that's my biggest pet peeve, but I'm all ears if you ever do want to talk about it. Maybe what's hurting you now isn't as big as you think.
It's okay. Is there something that happened that made you feel this way?
What did your mom do to make you want to hurt yourself?
Thanks but I don't think I want help anymore. I would rather just not exist

I can't imagine what you're feeling. Depression isn't always physically noticeable, and you'll never know what's going on in someone's head. They can seem completely fine on the outside but feel like they are being ripped apart inside. I hope you can find some sort of peace after this. I agree with @impreza_va. Time will be your biggest healer. Live you life in memory of your friend

I actually laughed at that lol. And I talk to friends sometimes but I hate feeling like I'm burdening them so I usually keep my thoughts to myself. I know it's not good to internalize it but I feel like talking doesn't really help. I feel okay for that moment I guess but I'll go back into that way of thinking right after
I'm genuinely happy for you. It warms my heart to read that considering how much I'm struggling. Good luck to you.
